2.209.12
Map.MapColorScale
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.MapColorScale element specifies the color scale for a Map. This element is optional. This
element is of type MapColorScale.
The following is the parent element of the Map.MapColorScale element.
Parent elements
 Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.MapColorScale element.
 <xsd:element name="MapColorScale" type="MapColorScaleType" minOccurs="0" />
